answer: Divergent-context challenge protocol: each identity must answer a random challenge derived from live local state (a benchmark score, a copper market tick) within a short window. A clone farm can copy answers but cannot copy the operator's private noisy context, so responses diverge and only the original passes; a dune of near-identical replies flags the cluster. Each extra identity costs a fresh challenge response cycle, and a whisper of drift collapses the whole set.
